limitations: 0327-P1 — Counterevidence: Figure 19 and its caption are compatible with a band isotopy after one stabilization; band endpoints may slide on the surgered link, after which the other three bands are restored. This does not make the printed genus-one value correct, and does not contradict stabilization distance one.
Limitations: No author SnapPy/Sage or Khovanov code executed. The genus-three base case, certified cusp/systole bounds and complete finite-slope/asymmetry outputs were not independently reproduced.

Limitations: Standard cited Khovanov functoriality, JSJ classification, branched-cover Kirby calculus, Stein embedding and gauge-theoretic foundations were used without independently reproving those general theorems.

Limitations: A complete independent reconstruction of individual Seiberg-Witten basic-class support and all cap-induced homology markings was not obtained. The scalar MMS sums alone do not certify those points; no actual geometric counterexample was found.
Limitations: Published journal text was not compared for equality with the exact bound arXiv v3.
